title: The CI paragraph of CLAUDE.md's pre-build section, with complaints

source.text: [`.github/workflows/test.yml`](.github/workflows/test.yml) runs `npm test` on every pull request and reports it as a check on the PR, so the test speaks even when no session runs the suite. `page-measures.yml` also runs on pull requests that touch a page, but only reports: a finding never fails it, so a red run is a fault in the pass, not in a page. The suite is browser-free by construction (`node --test` globs `node/test/**/*.test.mjs`, and every Playwright-driven check is named without `.test.`), so keep it that way or the runner grows a browser install. `package-lock.json` is gitignored, so CI resolves dependency ranges fresh on each run and a green check is not a claim about a pinned tree.

The suite stays browser-free because `node --test` globs `node/test/**/*.test.mjs`, so a Playwright-driven check must be named without `.test.`, or the CI runner would need a browser install. `package-lock.json` is gitignored, so CI resolves dependency ranges fresh per run: a green check pins no dependency versions.

[`.github/workflows/test.yml`](.github/workflows/test.yml) runs `npm test` on every pull request and reports a check on the PR, even when no session runs `npm test`. `page-measures.yml` runs on pull requests touching a page, but only reports findings, so a red run is a fault in the measuring scripts (`node/render/page-measures.mjs` and `node/test/page-measures.mjs`), not in a page. To keep the suite browser-free, name every Playwright-driven check without `.test.`, since `node --test` runs the files that match `node/test/**/*.test.mjs` and would otherwise make CI need a browser install. `package-lock.json` is gitignored, so CI resolves dependency ranges fresh per run: a green check claims nothing about a pinned dependency tree.

[`.github/workflows/test.yml`](.github/workflows/test.yml) runs `npm test` on pull requests that can merge and reports a status check on the PR, even when no session runs `npm test`. `page-measures.yml` runs on pull requests touching a page, but only reports measurement findings, which never fail the workflow, so a failed run is a fault in the measuring pass (`node/render/measure.mjs`, `node/render/page-measures.mjs` and `node/test/page-measures.mjs`), not in a page. To keep the test suite browser-free, name every Playwright check without `.test.`, else `node --test` picks up `node/test/**/*.test.mjs` and CI needs a browser install. `package-lock.json` is gitignored, so CI resolves dependency ranges fresh per run: a passing check says nothing about a fixed set of dependency versions.
